meta.name: dispatching-parallel-agents
meta.description: Use when facing 2+ independent tasks that can be worked on without shared state or sequential dependencies

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 并行执行多个独立任务，无需等待顺序完成
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要同时处理多个互不依赖的任务
copy.tagline_en: Execute multiple independent tasks in parallel without waiting
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to handle multiple independent tasks simultaneously

howto.what: 遇到多个互不相关的任务或测试失败时,Claude 会为每个独立问题域派一个专属子代理,在同一轮响应里并行派发,各自只带专门写好的指令和上下文,收回摘要后核对冲突并整体验证。
howto.when: 当出现 2 个以上可独立处理、彼此没有共享状态或先后依赖的任务时接管,例如多个测试文件因不同原因失败、多个子系统各自出问题等。

say.text: 这三个测试文件各自失败,原因互不相关,帮我并行修。
say.note: 会为每个文件派一个子代理同时处理

say.text: 把这几个独立子系统的排查分给不同子代理,再把结果整合给我。
say.note: 各自返回摘要后核对冲突并跑全量测试

say.text: 每个子代理只改指定文件,不要动生产代码。
say.note: 作为约束写进子代理指令

howto.what_en: For several unrelated tasks or failing tests, Claude dispatches one subagent per independent problem domain in one response so they run in parallel, then reads each summary, checks conflicts, and verifies the integrated result.
howto.when_en: Takes over when 2+ tasks are independent with no shared state or sequential dependency, e.g. several test files failing for different root causes.

say_en.text: Three test files fail for unrelated reasons — fix them in parallel.
say_en.note: One subagent per file, run concurrently

say_en.text: Split these independent subsystem investigations across subagents, then merge the results.
say_en.note: Each returns a summary; conflicts checked after

say_en.text: Each subagent edits only its file — don't touch production code.
say_en.note: Added as a constraint in agent prompts
